modalLead: nextDash finds the apps in your Docker containers and offers them as bookmarks. A fresh install starts with 98 example links on Slate, and an import asks where the bookmarks go.

items.text: nextDash finds your apps. A card lists the web apps running in your containers, grouped by kind and all ticked. Add puts them on the page with their icon and a status check, and an app that turns up later is asked about first.
items.title: Apps found on your server

media.alt: The apps found card: Plex, Jellyseerr, Grafana and Home Assistant grouped by kind, all ticked, with an Add button

items.text: Container labels steer it. nextdash.url, nextdash.name, nextdash.category, nextdash.icon and nextdash.hide=true set the address, name, category and icon, or keep a container out.
A fresh install starts with 98 example links on two pages. The first-start card asks whether to keep them or start empty.
Slate is the theme a new install starts on. Existing dashboards keep their theme.
An import asks where the bookmarks go: onto the dashboard, or into the inbox first. Into the inbox, a folder becomes a tag and links you already have are skipped.
items.title: Import to the inbox first

media.alt: The import question: onto the dashboard, or into the inbox first, with what each answer adds and skips

items.text: Clicking the "Press / to search names" hint now runs that search, and Tab and Shift+Tab no longer leave a stray prefix behind.
Code, addresses and shortcuts use Source Code Pro instead of the system's monospace font.
Read and unread follow the server again when you use more than one device, and Clear filters clears the address too.
